title: Stop making "basic" AI images. Do this instead.
description:
I show how I use Comfy UI to create an image generator with my own personal cinematography taste built in. I demonstrate by generating two images of an elephant—one without prompt enhancement and one with my pre-prompt on—to highlight the cinematic difference.

#chatgpt #openai #codex #comfyui #aifilmmaking
